verify: Re-render the same routes, viewport, input and motion preference.
Compare before/after findings without presenting fewer defects as aesthetic superiority.
Preserve working navigation, content, tokens and unrelated components.

limitations: Optional Playwright and a compatible browser are required.
Real submission/booking actions run only when explicitly supplied as authorized interaction fixtures.
Other engines and physical devices are not certified.
